title: Handcrafted Feature Extraction Engine Module Implementation

paragraphs: The Handcrafted Feature Extraction Engine module is a critical component in the ScholarPredict system, responsible for extracting hand-crafted visual features from produce images. The implementation details of this module are as follows:
- Target Platform: Python Machine Learning Workstation
- Image Preprocessing Pipeline: Image normalization, resizing, and illumination correction (OpenCV/PIL)
- Feature Extraction Engine: Handcrafted visual descriptor computation (Color Histograms & GLCM) (scikit-image/NumPy)
- KNN Classification Engine: Instance-based distance calculation and majority-vote prediction (scikit-learn)
- Dataset Management Subsystem: Dataset ingestion, label encoding, and train/test partition (pandas/File System)
- Modular code separation, exception handling, and input validation
- High computational efficiency, vectorized operations, and reproducible execution
